An '''outpost''' was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its complement included the [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s ''[[T-ST]]'' and ''[[T-SP]]'', the [[Class-A cargo container]] groups [[Vic (Class-A)|''Vic'']] and ''[[Limi]]'', the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] groups ''[[Enouck]]'' and ''[[Xarxis]]'', and the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] group ''[[Axet]]''. Sometime during the war, the outpost was [[Bombing of the Rebel outpost|attacked]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]], and it was destroyed along with its entire complement of [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. The attack was featured in the Imperial combat training simulator, in which [[TIE pilot|TIE bomber pilots]] could test their skills with the [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]].<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel outpost first appeared in the [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], developed by [[Totally Games]]. The bombing of the outpost is the third combat training mission for the TIE bomber, titled "Torpedo Run." The player can optionally inspect the craft of the outpost to achieve bonus goals.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />
